town_description: Satna is the headquarters of Satna district in the Baghelkhand region of Madhya Pradesh, on the NH-30 corridor. Founded in 1865 by Maharaja Raghuraj Singh of Rewa, it is a commercial and educational hub of the Vindhya region. It is the gateway to the Maihar Sharda temple, Chitrakoot and Ramvan, and takes its name from the Satna river, a tributary of the Tons.
